    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

## We make it possible.

# You make it matter.

Haemonetics provides a suite of innovative medical technology solutions that improve the quality,
effectiveness and efficiency of care. We challenge ourselves to think big and make new possibilities
a reality, so that our customers can make it matter for patients, every single day

[Haemonetics]
[Hospitals]

## Advancing Patient Care at Hospitals

We provide hospitals with quality solutions designed to enhance clinical outcomes, improve
procedural effectiveness and advance healthcare standards.

[Learn More][78]
[Plasma BU website]

## Optimizing Operations for Plasma Centers

We offer innovative technologies that enable higher plasma yield collections, help improve
productivity and quality in our customers’ centers, and enhance the overall donor experience.

[Learn More][79]
[Blood]

## Driving Efficiency for Blood Centers

We advance products and services to help ensure blood safety, improve operational efficiency and
collect the blood components in the greatest demand.

[Learn More][80]
[join our team]

CAREERS

## Join Our Winning Team

At Haemonetics, the work you do matters. Join us in advancing healthcare while you advance your own
career and make your ideas, commitment and passion matter every day.

[Learn how you can make it matter][81]
[making a difference]

OUR MISSION

## Making Our Work Matter

We develop innovative medical technology products and services that improve the quality,
effectiveness and efficiency of care. We are building a collaborative, performance-driven culture
that attracts and develops the best talent.

[See what drives us][82]
[guided by purpose]

CORPORATE RESPONSIBILITY

## Guided by Purpose

At Haemonetics, our Purpose inspires the important work we do every day to meaningfully advance
patient care and drive greater possibilities in healthcare. How we do this work is equally
important. We are guided by our Purpose, and mindful of our shareholders, customers, employees and
other key stakeholders whose trust we value. We are committed to being a good corporate citizen and
take responsibility to proactively identify and manage the environmental, social and governance
risks and opportunities that are relevant to our business and those we serve.

[Learn More][83]

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## Blood Center Solutions

Haemonetics' Blood Center Business is committed to helping blood centers manage blood collections
safely, collect the blood components in the greatest demand and attract and retain the right donors.
Our comprehensive portfolio enables our customers to provide safe, high-quality blood components to
hospitals and their patients around the world.

### Apheresis

Haemonetics' Apheresis Collection Systems offer the flexibility to collect high-quality blood
components to meet patient needs. They combine all attributes of a multicomponent collection system
within a small, portable and easy-to-use designs.

### Cell Processing

The ACP^{® }215 Automated Cell Processor is the world’s first and only automated, closed system
processor of washed and frozen red blood cells. It minimizes the risk of bacterial contamination,
while giving donor centers and hospitals the safety and flexibility they need.

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

# Biomedical Microdevice (BioMD) Laboratory

## Welcome to Biomedical Microdevice Lab in HKUST!

We are in the pursuit of advanced microfluidic devices to address practical issues in life science
and medicine. Our research interests primarily include siliconbased fabrication, nucleic acid
analysis, patch clamp electrophysiology, electrokinetic-based separation, droplet microfluidics,
dielectrophoresis, biomicrofluidics, and lab-on-a-chip systems for biomedical applications.

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

# Live Forever Club

## How to live long enough to live forever

Longevity, life extension, biological immortality, rejuvenation, living forever... whatever you want
to call it, you're in the right place.

The Live Forever Club collates news articles, useful resources and lots of practical tips about
living longer, healthier lives. All of the information is available to everyone - part of the club's
philosophy of [equality in longevity][91] - with [members][92] getting unlimited access and some
extra features (free and paid options available).

Explore what's going on in the longevity industry with 5,000 curated news articles, over 11,000
resources (companies, people, products) and over 100 [blog posts][93].

NO NONSENSE POLICY! The club tracks down the latest scientific research on the causes of ageing and
effects on life expectancy, and also keeps you abreast of the wider impacts of life extension and
the consequences for society when it arrives. We do our best to only include **evidence-based
**approaches to longevity and wellness - no clickbait articles from us.

Want to live forever? [Join the club][94]! See the [benefits of membership][95].

To help us raise awareness of the progress in longevity and life extension, can you help us with a
small donation? Find out how a donation of any size helps us reach the people who can demand
change: [Donation information][96]

Highlights

You find find related news on every page, but here are a few of our favourites:
* European researchers have developed [Delphi-2M – a large language model (LLM) that uses diagnosis
  instead of words][97]. It’s also time-aware, allowing it to predict future disease events, using
  just normal health records, as much as 10 years ahead.
* [Johns Hopkins University has developed a new robot][98] able to perform a whole gallbladder
  removal operation from start to finish after being trained using video footage of human surgeries
  and powered by artificial intelligence (on a pig, obviously there is going to be some paperwork
  involved before human trials!). Imagine if the time taken to train a new surgeon shrunk to just
  the time it takes to manufacture a new robot - no more waiting lists.
* ARPA-H has announced its [FRONT program – an initiative aiming to restore brain function][99]
  using stem cells and regenerative medicine. FRONT is looking to develop a curative therapy for
  damage caused by strokes and traumatic brain injuries, enabling patients to to regain lost
  functions, such as motor control, vision, and speech.

We read as many longevity books as possible and write quick reviews to help you decide whether they
are for you.

Explore the different areas of the site for news, resources and information a a wide variety of
longevity topics:

[Medical Technology][107] - track the rapid advances in medicine and healthcare

[Health][108] - avoid the big killers to buy time until medical technology catches up

[Augmentation][109] - enhance your body with improved muscles, vision and direct brain interfacing

[Life Extension][110] - slow aging and rejuvenate your body with new cells and organs

[Survival][111] - even when biologically immortal you've still got to avoid dying from accidents or
natural disasters

[How To Live Forever][112] - covers topics that will help you make lifestyle choices to improve your
chances of living long enough to live forever

And the [events calendar][113] let you know about upcoming longevity events that you can attend such
as Vitalist Bay and Genii Longevity.

take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## The Journal of Modern Medical & Dental Sciences

[[Medical Channel]][52]Since its inception in 1994, the Medical Channel Journal has provided the
medical community in Pakistan and abroad with an invaluable service. As one of the leading medical &
dental sciences publications in Pakistan, it has sought to continue the education of medical
students and postgraduates through scientific research, review articles and updates on contemporary
clinical practices while providing an ongoing forum for medical debate. A measure of our stature is
that we are listed in the Index Medicus and duly approved by Pakistan medical & dental council and
Higher Education Commission of Pakistan.

As a general medical journal, the Medical Channel seeks to represent every facet and domain of the
medical profession. In this respect, we rely on the medical community to inform us of any successes
and advances in their particular fields, their grievances, their hopes for the future and ultimately
ways of improving patient care. Medical Education is a two way process and we are dedicated to
improving the content and scope of this journal.

The Medical Channel is more than just a medical journal. It is part of the fabric and culture of
medicine in Pakistan. We want it to be not only educational but also enjoyable to our readers. Any
subjects or topics which impinge on medicine or which you feel are of interest to the medical
community, we openly welcome.

We appreciate contributions from every quarter! Original papers, short reports, case reports,
letters, reviews, observations, criticisms, conference reports, clinical news, and not least medical
musings.
So start writing today!

Prof. Iqbal A. Memon
Editor in Chief

## Technologies for Exceptional Patient Care

Our mission is to work as a team to save one more life, today and every day. We do this by providing
lifesaving technology to cardiac surgery teams around the world.

### Oxygenation Systems

Terumo introduced the world’s first hollow fiber oxygenator, and continues to lead the way in
innovation and quality.
[Learn More →][55]

### Monitoring Systems

Terumo’s CDI Systems are the world’s most trusted and used continuous in-line blood gas monitors.
[Learn More →][56]

### Heart-lung Machines

Terumo manufactures the longest running line of commercially available heart-lung machines in the
world, and is a leader in quality systems management.
[Learn More →][57]

### EVH Products

Terumo’s endoscopic vessel harvesting products are designed for safety and efficiency, delivering
quality results to clinicians and patients.

Dr. James Kingsley is a caring physician who listens to patients’ symptoms and stories with empathy
and kindness. He founded The Kingsley Clinic to provide high-quality, evidence-based healthcare to
all patients, no matter their background or circumstance.

## What we Treat

If you’re looking for an urgent care nearby, but prefer to avoid exposure to COVID-19 or simply
prefer the convenience of seeing an online doctor, then we can help you at the Kingsley Clinic.  If
you would like to know whether what you need to be seen for can be managed online ask our front desk
for help.  If it is something you are planning to have evaluated at an urgent care center or it’s
something that your primary care physician typically helps you with, then a Kingsley Clinic doctor
can help you.

Our board certified doctors see and treat patients with both new symptoms and chronic medical
conditions.  We can also help with any medication refills or referrals you might need. Our
physicians see pediatric, adult and geriatric patients.

detailed industry categorization, tag-based filtering, and headquarters location information, makes
it straightforward to explore brands by country, category, or parent company. Use our search tools

hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.

## We make it possible.

# You make it matter.

Haemonetics provides a suite of innovative medical technology solutions that improve the quality,
effectiveness and efficiency of care. We challenge ourselves to think big and make new possibilities
a reality, so that our customers can make it matter for patients, every single day

[Haemonetics]
[Hospitals]

## Advancing Patient Care at Hospitals

We provide hospitals with quality solutions designed to enhance clinical outcomes, improve
procedural effectiveness and advance healthcare standards.

[Learn More][78]
[Plasma BU website]

## Optimizing Operations for Plasma Centers

We offer innovative technologies that enable higher plasma yield collections, help improve
productivity and quality in our customers’ centers, and enhance the overall donor experience.

[Learn More][79]
[Blood]

## Driving Efficiency for Blood Centers

We advance products and services to help ensure blood safety, improve operational efficiency and
collect the blood components in the greatest demand.

[Learn More][80]
[join our team]

CAREERS

## Join Our Winning Team

At Haemonetics, the work you do matters. Join us in advancing healthcare while you advance your own
career and make your ideas, commitment and passion matter every day.

[Learn how you can make it matter][81]
[making a difference]

OUR MISSION

## Making Our Work Matter

We develop innovative medical technology products and services that improve the quality,
effectiveness and efficiency of care. We are building a collaborative, performance-driven culture
that attracts and develops the best talent.

[See what drives us][82]
[guided by purpose]

CORPORATE RESPONSIBILITY

## Guided by Purpose

At Haemonetics, our Purpose inspires the important work we do every day to meaningfully advance
patient care and drive greater possibilities in healthcare. How we do this work is equally
important. We are guided by our Purpose, and mindful of our shareholders, customers, employees and
other key stakeholders whose trust we value. We are committed to being a good corporate citizen and
take responsibility to proactively identify and manage the environmental, social and governance
risks and opportunities that are relevant to our business and those we serve.

[Learn More][83]

processor of washed and frozen red blood cells. It minimizes the risk of bacterial contamination,

and medicine. Our research interests primarily include siliconbased fabrication, nucleic acid
analysis, patch clamp electrophysiology, electrokinetic-based separation, droplet microfluidics,
dielectrophoresis, biomicrofluidics, and lab-on-a-chip systems for biomedical applications.

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals

  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions

  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

# Live Forever Club

## How to live long enough to live forever

Longevity, life extension, biological immortality, rejuvenation, living forever... whatever you want
to call it, you're in the right place.

The Live Forever Club collates news articles, useful resources and lots of practical tips about
living longer, healthier lives. All of the information is available to everyone - part of the club's
philosophy of [equality in longevity][91] - with [members][92] getting unlimited access and some
extra features (free and paid options available).

Explore what's going on in the longevity industry with 5,000 curated news articles, over 11,000
resources (companies, people, products) and over 100 [blog posts][93].

NO NONSENSE POLICY! The club tracks down the latest scientific research on the causes of ageing and
effects on life expectancy, and also keeps you abreast of the wider impacts of life extension and
the consequences for society when it arrives. We do our best to only include **evidence-based
**approaches to longevity and wellness - no clickbait articles from us.

Want to live forever? [Join the club][94]! See the [benefits of membership][95].

To help us raise awareness of the progress in longevity and life extension, can you help us with a
small donation? Find out how a donation of any size helps us reach the people who can demand
change: [Donation information][96]

Highlights

You find find related news on every page, but here are a few of our favourites:
* European researchers have developed [Delphi-2M – a large language model (LLM) that uses diagnosis
  instead of words][97]. It’s also time-aware, allowing it to predict future disease events, using
  just normal health records, as much as 10 years ahead.
* [Johns Hopkins University has developed a new robot][98] able to perform a whole gallbladder
  removal operation from start to finish after being trained using video footage of human surgeries
  and powered by artificial intelligence (on a pig, obviously there is going to be some paperwork
  involved before human trials!). Imagine if the time taken to train a new surgeon shrunk to just
  the time it takes to manufacture a new robot - no more waiting lists.
* ARPA-H has announced its [FRONT program – an initiative aiming to restore brain function][99]
  using stem cells and regenerative medicine. FRONT is looking to develop a curative therapy for
  damage caused by strokes and traumatic brain injuries, enabling patients to to regain lost
  functions, such as motor control, vision, and speech.

## The Journal of Modern Medical & Dental Sciences

[[Medical Channel]][52]Since its inception in 1994, the Medical Channel Journal has provided the
medical community in Pakistan and abroad with an invaluable service. As one of the leading medical &
dental sciences publications in Pakistan, it has sought to continue the education of medical
students and postgraduates through scientific research, review articles and updates on contemporary
clinical practices while providing an ongoing forum for medical debate. A measure of our stature is
that we are listed in the Index Medicus and duly approved by Pakistan medical & dental council and
Higher Education Commission of Pakistan.

As a general medical journal, the Medical Channel seeks to represent every facet and domain of the
medical profession. In this respect, we rely on the medical community to inform us of any successes
and advances in their particular fields, their grievances, their hopes for the future and ultimately
ways of improving patient care. Medical Education is a two way process and we are dedicated to
improving the content and scope of this journal.

The Medical Channel is more than just a medical journal. It is part of the fabric and culture of
medicine in Pakistan. We want it to be not only educational but also enjoyable to our readers. Any
subjects or topics which impinge on medicine or which you feel are of interest to the medical
community, we openly welcome.

We appreciate contributions from every quarter! Original papers, short reports, case reports,
letters, reviews, observations, criticisms, conference reports, clinical news, and not least medical
musings.
So start writing today!

Prof. Iqbal A. Memon
Editor in Chief

## The Journal of Modern Medical & Dental Sciences

[[Medical Channel]][52]Since its inception in 1994, the Medical Channel Journal has provided the
medical community in Pakistan and abroad with an invaluable service. As one of the leading medical &
dental sciences publications in Pakistan, it has sought to continue the education of medical
students and postgraduates through scientific research, review articles and updates on contemporary
clinical practices while providing an ongoing forum for medical debate. A measure of our stature is
that we are listed in the Index Medicus and duly approved by Pakistan medical & dental council and
Higher Education Commission of Pakistan.

As a general medical journal, the Medical Channel seeks to represent every facet and domain of the
medical profession. In this respect, we rely on the medical community to inform us of any successes
and advances in their particular fields, their grievances, their hopes for the future and ultimately
ways of improving patient care. Medical Education is a two way process and we are dedicated to
improving the content and scope of this journal.

The Medical Channel is more than just a medical journal. It is part of the fabric and culture of
medicine in Pakistan. We want it to be not only educational but also enjoyable to our readers. Any
subjects or topics which impinge on medicine or which you feel are of interest to the medical
community, we openly welcome.

We appreciate contributions from every quarter! Original papers, short reports, case reports,
letters, reviews, observations, criticisms, conference reports, clinical news, and not least medical
musings.
So start writing today!

Prof. Iqbal A. Memon

Dr. James Kingsley is a caring physician who listens to patients’ symptoms and stories with empathy

all patients, no matter their background or circumstance.

## What we Treat

If you’re looking for an urgent care nearby, but prefer to avoid exposure to COVID-19 or simply
prefer the convenience of seeing an online doctor, then we can help you at the Kingsley Clinic.  If
you would like to know whether what you need to be seen for can be managed online ask our front desk
for help.  If it is something you are planning to have evaluated at an urgent care center or it’s
something that your primary care physician typically helps you with, then a Kingsley Clinic doctor
can help you.

Our board certified doctors see and treat patients with both new symptoms and chronic medical
conditions.  We can also help with any medication refills or referrals you might need. Our
physicians see pediatric, adult and geriatric patients.

### Defend yourself against tracking and surveillance. Circumvent censorship.

[ Download Tor Browser ][36]
[Block Trackers]

#### BLOCK TRACKERS

Tor Browser isolates each website you visit so third-party trackers and ads can't follow you. Any
cookies automatically clear when you're done browsing. So will your browsing history.

[Defend Against Surveillance]

#### DEFEND AGAINST SURVEILLANCE

Tor Browser prevents someone watching your connection from knowing what websites you visit. All
anyone monitoring your browsing habits can see is that you're using Tor.

[Resist Fingerprinting]

#### RESIST FINGERPRINTING

Tor Browser aims to make all users look the same, making it difficult for you to be fingerprinted
based on your browser and device information.

[Multi-layered Encryption]

#### MULTI-LAYERED ENCRYPTION

Your traffic is relayed and encrypted three times as it passes over the Tor network. The network is
comprised of thousands of volunteer-run servers known as Tor relays.

[Browse Freely]

#### BROWSE FREELY

With Tor Browser, you are free to access sites your home network may have blocked.

## Research-Backed and Regularly Updated

Accuracy matters when it comes to corporate ownership data. Our editorial team tracks corporate
filings, press releases, merger announcements, and public records to maintain reliable and current
information. Each brand profile includes founding details, acquisition timelines, parent company
profiles, headquarters locations, and manufacturing countries sourced from official disclosures. We
update our records regularly to reflect the latest mergers, acquisitions, and corporate
restructurings happening around the world. This commitment to accuracy, transparency, and editorial
thoroughness is what makes Who Brands a trusted resource for consumers, researchers, and journalists
seeking verified ownership information.

## Make Informed Consumer Choices

Knowing who owns a brand helps you align your spending with your values. Some consumers prefer to
support locally headquartered companies, while others look for brands backed by organizations with
strong sustainability commitments or proven industry expertise. Our ownership data, combined with
detailed industry categorization, tag-based filtering, and headquarters location information, makes
it straightforward to explore brands by country, category, or parent company. Use our search tools
and filters to find brands that match what matters most to you, compare corporate portfolios side by
side, and take meaningful control of your purchasing decisions.
